Real-data files (`gap_vs_n`, `matrix_facts`, others) follow when the matrix is assembled; I will use your file names and column names. Per-file definitions are in `README.md` ("Result files delivered so far").
  > 
  > What it shows for the claim: the equal-θ predictor tracks the gap within ~7% when noise dominates true spread, and overshoots it (median ratio 1.2–1.3 at n=400, 1.6–1.75 at n=800 for σ_θ>0) as n grows — so on the synthetic arm it is an upper reading, not an equality, once σ_θ√n is large. Fig 2 should show predicted next to gap per σ_θ stratum so this reads off the plot.
